claim: In Gravesend a leaf drawn open was traced open by the light model, so its faces came out in patches of different shade that moved with it; a sliding or rotating sector's (616, 617) faces must take one shade.
evidence: Gravesend's second playthrough, 2026-11-23 (commit 41ac4b8); fixed by bloodmap/light_stage.py:1149 even_movers, called at :1343 after the shade pass.
use: After any light pass, even the shade of the faces of every sector that moves whole (616, 617): light_stage.even_movers gives them the length-weighted mean.

checked.how: Opened bloodmap/light_stage.py:1149-1171 (even_movers): only sectors of type 616 and 617 are evened, to the length-weighted mean shade of their faces, and a mover touching a kept sector is skipped; called at :1343 after shade().
